svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/141.0.0.0" version="28.2.7" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="f5i6fUIuyXn0RvjLXkOx"> <mxGraphModel dx="1443" dy="671" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
' // Titling and theming
title Voice-Controlled Braille Display Workflow
skinparam sequenceArrowThickness 2
skinparam roundcorner 20
skinparam maxmessagesize 120
skinparam sequenceParticipant bold

' // Defining the actors and components (lifelines)
actor \"User\" as user
participant \"USB Microphone\" as mic
participant \"Raspberry Pi \n(Python Script)\" as rpi
participant \"Servo Motors\" as servos

' // Describing the sequence of events
user -> mic: Speaks a word (e.g., \"CAT\")
activate user

mic -> rpi: Sends raw audio data
activate mic
activate rpi

rpi -> rpi: 1. Speech Recognition
note right: Converts audio data to text string: \"CAT\"

rpi -> rpi: 2. Braille Logic Mapping
note right: Maps \"C\"->[1,4], \"A\"->[1], \"T\"->[2,3,4,5]

loop for each character in \"CAT\"
 rpi -> rpi: 3. Calculate Servo Angles
 note right: For 'C': Servo1=UP, Servo4=UP, others=DOWN

 rpi -> servos: 4. Send GPIO Signals
 activate servos

 servos -> servos: Move to designated positions
 deactivate servos
end

deactivate rpi
deactivate mic
deactivate user

@enduml",
 "format": "png"
}" id="wWf_NpR2zXjLfDLFO3p1-3"> <mxCell style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/png,;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="62" y="10" width="726" height="589" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
